title: EXP-006 — Literal Form Caption Persistence Across Documented Coupled Unload
objective: Create a new User-scope classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_FormPropertyLab03` using the verified basic-form recipe, record its baseline Form properties and exact User-scope identity, change only its literal Caption to `Form Property Lab Coupled Unload`, save normally, close the Form, leave `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` unchanged, invoke the documented Form/global-object unload from the supported Form > Definition UI while explicitly permitting incidental IDO-metadata clearing, then reopen exactly the same Form version and verify that the Caption persisted and all recorded comparison properties remained unchanged. Record the exact unload command label rendered by the 2026.09.08 UI as an observation rather than assuming its wording.

acceptance_checks.description: Before mutation, evidence proves that no exact or case-insensitive `FX_FormPropertyLab03` exists in the accessible Form list.

After creation, evidence proves exactly one `FX_FormPropertyLab03` exists and that its editing identity is ScopeType=User with the recorded ScopeName; baseline Caption, Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, and Is Master are captured.
Evidence proves that only Caption was changed to exactly `Form Property Lab Coupled Unload`, ordinary Designer Save completed, and the Form returned to a clean state.

Read-only evidence records the current `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` preference state immediately before the explicit unload, and evidence confirms the preference was not changed by this experiment.
Evidence captures the Form > Definition submenu in the 2026.09.08 environment and records the exact visible label of the documented Form/global-object unload command before invoking it.

Evidence proves that the supported Form/global-object unload command was invoked successfully with the existing preference left unchanged; incidental IDO-metadata clearing is explicitly permitted and is not considered a failure.
After the unload, evidence proves that exactly `FX_FormPropertyLab03` with ScopeType=User and the same recorded ScopeName was reopened.

After reopen, evidence proves Caption is exactly `Form Property Lab Coupled Unload` and the recorded comparison properties Description, Version, Device Type, Form Type, and Is Master match their pre-edit baseline values.
Final evidence and experiment record confirm that no artifact other than `FX_FormPropertyLab03` was created or modified and that no User Preference was changed.

notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261001-234209-2iFN. Rationale: EXP-005 established that an ordinary Designer Save can persist a literal Form Caption through close/reopen, but EXP-005-R2 could not complete its stronger cache-boundary verification because that replay's own isolation rules prohibited IDO-metadata clearing while the current user's `Unload IDO Metadata With Forms` preference was enabled. Current Mongoose guidance indicates that the documented Form/global-object unload remains valid with that preference enabled and may intentionally clear IDO metadata in the same operation. The smallest independent next step is therefore a new experiment, not a workaround or continuation of the blocked R2: repeat the already-observed literal-Caption operation on a new FX_ Form while explicitly permitting incidental IDO-metadata clearing, leave the user's preference unchanged, invoke the documented Form > Definition unload command, and verify the exact User-scope Form version afterward.
